description: The common 8-digit red 7-segment display module: a MAX7219 driving two 0.36" 4-digit common-cathode displays on an 82 x 15 mm board, plugged into a 1x5 female header at its input end: VCC GND DIN CS CLK as the module prints them

datasheet.revision: the module's silkscreen (VCC GND DIN CS CLK); Maxim MAX7219 datasheet 19-4452 Rev 4

package.name: MAX7219 8-digit module, 1 x 5 socket
package.page: the module's board 82 x 15 mm with its 1x5 input header across its left end; two 4-digit 0.36 inch displays (30.2 x 14 x 7.2 mm) in the middle; 0.3 inch digit pitch

footprint: moduleSocket("MAX7219_8digit_Module_Socket_1x05_P2.54mm", socketRow(1, 5, (-38.6mm, 5.08mm), (0mm, -2.54mm)), box((-41mm, -7.5mm), (41mm, 7.5mm)), description = "MAX7219 8-digit 7-segment module on a 1x5 female header across its left end: VCC, GND, DIN, CS, CLK from the top; the digits centred on the footprint's origin", parts = 7.2mm, color = "#1d5e8c", module = concat([ solid.box((30.2mm, 14mm, 7.2mm), at = (15.6mm, 0mm, 0mm), radius = 0.2mm, color = "#151517"), solid.box((30.2mm, 14mm, 7.2mm), at = (-15.6mm, 0mm, 0mm), radius = 0.2mm, color = "#151517"), solid.box((7.6mm, 7.6mm, 1.2mm), at = (-35mm, -2mm, 0mm), radius = 0.1mm, material = .epoxy) ], digitSegments(8, 7.8mm, 7.2mm)))

pins.name: VCC
pins.description: 5 V (the LEDs draw up to about 200 mA at full brightness)

notes: Buy the module (it carries the MAX7219, its RSET and decoupling and the displays); this footprint is the header it plugs into.
The MAX7219 reads 3.5 V as high: from a 3.3 V controller use a 74HCT buffer.
Chain more modules from the output end (DOUT to the next DIN).
